scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,yellow "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all:windows: npm.cmd install --prefix server && npm.cmd install --prefix client
scripts.dev:windows: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,yellow "npm.cmd run dev --prefix server" "npm.cmd run dev --prefix client"
